text:
maria_marketing: Quick ask — we're finalizing the launch post and need a focused sanity rerun for the quantized embeddings workflow. Can runtime run a tiny cohort (100 queries) comparing fp16 vs int8 quantized on the prod-like pool? Need p50/p95/p99 and embed cosine stability.

alex_runtime: Yep. Quick clarifying q's: which model variant exactly, sequence lengths, and do you want cold-start included or warmed pool? Also what's the SLA window for results?

maria_marketing: Model: redwood/open-7b-v2 (the one in the catalog). Seq len: ~128 tokens for prompt, embeddings are from final hidden state. Please include cold-start and warmed (5-min warmup) runs. Deadline: EOD Wed (48h).

jordan_runtime: For reproducibility send sample payloads and the RNG seed you used in staging. Also say whether batching simulates 10qps or bursty? impacts latency.

sam_marketing: We'll attach sample.csv (100 rows) and seed=42. Target traffic: steady 10 qps + a 30s burst at 50 qps to show tail.

alex_runtime: Cool. We'll run: 1) cold coldstart single-instance cold cache, 2) warmed after 5m steady 10 qps, 3) quantized int8 variant. We'll capture token-level timing, KV cache hit/miss, and raw embeddings. Any privacy redactions?

maria_marketing: No PII, synthetic queries only. Please keep raw embeddings and traces private — share links with marketing and eng-runtime only.

runtime-ci: Started job run-3619998888-a. Estimated runtime 40m. Link: https://ci.redwood/run/3619998888-a

jordan_runtime: Heads-up: quantized model had a small regen in the catalog last week; we'll pin to digest sha256:0xabc123 to match marketing samples.

alex_runtime: Got it. Will post summary + CSV with p50/p95/p99, mean cos similarity delta, and a short runbook of steps to reproduce. If we hit >5% cosine degradation between fp16 and int8, flag for product review.

maria_marketing: Perfect — please ping this thread when the artifacts are up. :pray:

runtime-ci: Job run-3619998888-a completed. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/3619998888-a (metrics.csv, traces.tar.gz, embeddings.zip)

alex_runtime: Uploading summary now. TL;DR: p95 latency warm=120ms, cold=340ms; int8 cosine drop mean=0.8%, p99 tail diff negligible. Putting full artifact links in the report.

maria_marketing: Awesome — thanks team. We'll pull numbers into the launch post and follow up if we need a deeper rerun.

sam_marketing: Noted — grabbing the artifacts now.
